newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Baltic cargo ship reported out of danger.
newsitem.headline: Baltic cargo ship reported out of danger.

text.p: Coastguards said a cargo vessel that sent out a distress signal in high winds off the Lithuanian coast on Thursday was out of danger later in the day, the Baltic News Service (BNS) reported.
Lithuanian coastguard officals said the 5,970-ton Silvia, registered in St. Vincent, had entered Latvian waters and was steaming toward the port of Liepaja.
The Lithuanian coastguards had prepared to rescue the Silvia's 20 crew after the ship radioed for help, saying it had engine trouble and the winds were driving it dangerously close to shore.
The bad weather forced the Latvian oil port of Ventspils to close on Wednesday night.
